annotation.title_clean: 貨物自動車運送事業輸送安全規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance on Transport Safety in the Freight Motor Vehicle Transportation Business
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (formerly Ministry of Transport), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance setting transport-safety duties for freight motor carriers (safety management rules, driver hours, roll calls, records, operations managers). Amended to cover 'specified automated operation' trucks, requiring specified automated operation safety personnel, remote monitoring, and cybersecurity provisions. Version in force from April 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Carriers must adopt safety management rules, appoint a safety manager and publish safety information annually.
Automated-operation trucks require an onboard safety officer or equivalent, or remote monitoring from a business office.
Carriers must ensure systems and arrangements for automated freight operation, including roll calls verifying automated driving device settings.
Duty to train, supervise and keep records for automated-operation safety personnel.
Designated carriers' safety rules must address cybersecurity of critical computer systems.
